# Luxembourg Help Topics

Luxembourg Help Topics (14 pages): Luxembourg Help Topics

## Chapters
- [Luxembourg Help Topics](chapter_156811878876.md): Overview The following help topics contain information about NetSuite features that are specific to companies doing business in Luxembourg.
  - [Luxembourg Account Setup](section_156819875118.md): Setting up an account for an organization doing business in Luxembourg usually requires enabling several features and installing some additional SuiteApps.
  - [Setting Up Luxembourg-specific Preferences](section_156820162256.md): To set up your NetSuite account according to business requirements in Luxembourg, you must adjust your NetSuite company, and subsidiary settings.
  - [Note About Luxembourg VAT Rates](article_0104034803.md): Luxembourg is implementing changes in the standard, intermediate, and reduced VAT rates effective on January 1-December 31, 2023.
  - [Luxembourg Tax Topics For Accounts Without SuiteTax](section_156862264625.md): If you have a Luxembourg nexus and you have the International Tax Reports SuiteApp installed in your NetSuite account, you can generate the monthly and quarterly Luxembourg VAT returns in English or French.
  - [Luxembourg Payment Formats](section_156864104822.md): The Electronic Bank Payments SuiteApp allows businesses to pay vendor bills, employee expenses, customer refunds, and partner commissions, as well as receive payments from customers within Luxembourg, by generating payment files in the following formats: - VIR 2000 standard of the Luxembourg Bankers Association (ABBL) - SEPA Credit Transfer specifications of ABBL - SEPA Credit Transfer specifications of HSBC To set up the Electronic Bank Payments SuiteApp for your company, subsidiaries, vendors, employees, customers, and partners in Luxembourg, read the following topics: - Setting Up Company Bank Records in Luxembourg(https://docs.
